text: {"final": {"summary": "In inventory/stock.py's reserve_stock, added a warehouse_id validation at the top of the function: imported is_valid_warehouse_id from core.ids and raise ValueError(f\"invalid warehouse id: {warehouse_id!r}\") when the check fails. The check runs before the ledger is loaded or appended and before the insufficient-stock 'pending' path, so rejected codes record nothing in the ledger. Valid IDs like 'WH-NVL-03' pass unchanged, preserving existing behavior.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
